description:
Pioneer 2 Long Range Electric Bike
Dominate the Outdoors with the All-New Pioneer 2 Electric Bike
The Dirwin Pioneer 2 is engineered for hunters, outdoor explorers, and riders who need maximum power, range, and reliability in the backcountry. Built tougher, stronger, and smarter than ever, the Pioneer 2 takes everything riders love about the Pioneer and pushes performance to the next level. From rugged forest trails to steep access roads and long days in the field, this hunting electric bike is designed to carry you—and all your gear—farther with total confidence.
Extreme Power & Range for Serious Off-Road Riders
The Pioneer 2 features a high-torque 750W motor (1000W peak) that easily conquers climbs, loose terrain, and rough ground. A massive 30AH battery delivers up to 120 miles of real-world range, giving hunters the freedom to scout deeper, check more trail cameras, and reach remote spots without worrying about running out of power.
Smoother, Smarter Pedal Assist for Technical Terrain
Equipped with an advanced Torque & Cadence Sensor, the Pioneer 2 responds instantly to your pedaling for a natural, efficient, and ghost-pedal-free ride. Combined with a new 10-speed drivetrain, you get extra control and precision on steep grades, technical trails, and heavily loaded rides.
Built to Handle Any Surface You Encounter
This all-terrain electric bike comes equipped with 26” × 4.0” puncture-resistant fat tires for unbeatable grip on dirt, rocks, mud, sand, or snow. A hydraulic suspension fork and upgraded seat post suspension absorb bumps and impacts, keeping your ride stable and comfortable even on long or difficult routes.
Carry More, Travel Farther, Hunt Smarter
The Pioneer 2 now includes an integrated rear rack that’s welded directly into the frame—strong enough to safely carry an additional passenger or heavy gear without compromising stability. With an upgraded 450-lb total carrying capacity, this electric hunting bike can haul equipment, harvests, and supplies with ease.
The deeper step-through frame also makes mounting and dismounting much easier, especially when loaded with gear or layered in hunting apparel.
Designed for Serious Riding, Certified for Safety
With a top speed of 28 MPH, powerful Tektro hydraulic disc brakes, and full UL certification, the Pioneer 2 delivers the confidence and durability demanded by off-road riders. Whether you're packing in for the season or hitting the woods before sunrise, this bike is built to perform when it matters most.
Two frame sizes, one bike
The Pioneer 2 comes in two frame sizes. Both share the same 750W motor, 30AH battery, up to 120 miles of range, integrated rear rack, 450 lb capacity and full UL certification. Only the wheels and the drivetrain differ.

L (26") frame 26" x 4" puncture-resistant Kenda fat tires, 10-speed drivetrain. Seat height 31.3" to 42.3". Fits riders about 5'6" to 6'4". $2,399.

S (20") frame 20" x 4" puncture-resistant Kenda fat tires, 8-speed drivetrain. Seat height 28" to 39", and 9" shorter overall, so it is easier to fit in a garage or on a rack. Fits riders about 5'0" to 6'0". $2,299.

Both frames are deep step-throughs with a standover under 21", so mounting is easy on either. The difference that matters is seat height: the S drops 3.3" lower, which is what makes it work for shorter riders.
Key Features

750W motor (1000W peak) for off-road torque

30AH high-capacity battery with up to 120 miles of range

3.5" TFT LCD Color Display with USB-C charging port

Integrated rear rack strong enough to carry an extra passenger

450-lb total load capacity for hauling gear and game

Torque & Cadence sensor for smoother, more responsive pedal assist

10-speed drivetrain on the L frame, 8-speed on the S frame

Seat post suspension for greater comfort on long rides

Deeper step-through frame for easier mounting

26" x 4.0" fat tires on the L frame, 20" x 4.0" on the S frame

Hydraulic suspension fork

180mm Hydraulic disc brakes

28 MPH top speed

UL certified for safety and reliability
